description:
In this Q & A program the following questions will be answered:
- If Jesus is our High Priest and He has to purify the sanctuary in heaven, are there sins in the sanctuary as it was in the earthly sanctuary?
- Lucifer is created by God. God created everything. How come God didn't prevent sin from coming into this world?
- Can you please explain Romans 7:1-6?

I'd Like To Know is a weekly live SUMTV.org program - Every Tuesday at 4:30pm Pacific Time. Additional Bible studies are available at SecretsUnsealed.org.
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program.
